name: Abū ʿUthmān Saʿīd ibn Hārūn al-Ushnāndānī
summary: Basran master of the language, pupil of al-Tawwazī and teacher of Ibn Durayd, who praised him for answering the questions of rare words that Abū Ḥātim and al-Riyāshī could not.
bio: Al-Ushnāndānī took from Abū Muḥammad al-Tawwazī, and Ibn Durayd took from him. Ibn al-Anbārī tells, on Ibn Durayd's authority, how Ibn Durayd asked Abū Ḥātim al-Sijistānī and al-Riyāshī about the derivation of rare words in vain and had his answer from al-Ushnāndānī.
Al-Zubaydī counts him in the sixth generation of the lexicographers of Basra. Ibn al-Anbārī gives no year of his death.

sources.title: Ibn al-Anbārī, Nuzhat al-alibbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-udabāʾ (Cairo 1294/1877), pp. 266–267
